instruction: Create a battle over UI panel scene and its script. Add res://scenes/ui/battle_over_panel.tscn with a root Panel named BattleOverPanel, set process mode to Always, and stretch it to full rect. Override the panel style with a StyleBoxFlat using rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.47). Add a centered VBoxContainer with offsets -36/-36/36/36. Inside it, add a Label named Label with text "Encounter Won", centered horizontal and vertical alignment, and LabelSettings font_size 31. Add two Buttons named ContinueButton and RestartButton, each with custom_minimum_size (80, 28), size_flags_horizontal set to Expand, and texts "Next Round" and "Reset Fight" respectively. Create res://scenes/ui/battle_over_panel.gd that class_names BattleOverPanel, defines enum Type {WIN, LOSE}, binds the Label and both Buttons with % paths, connects ContinueButton to get_tree().quit and RestartButton to get_tree().reload_current_scene in _ready, and connects Events.battle_over_screen_requested to show_screen. Implement show_screen(text, type) to update the label text, toggle ContinueButton for WIN and RestartButton for LOSE, show the panel, and pause the scene tree.
